title: The flats, from behind
logline: The mudflats at low tide, a man from behind walking away across them with the pup, the two-one prints coming toward the reader. The sequence's rule in its widest place: the whole bay, and only a back.

panels.composition: Wide mudflats at low tide with a man in blue plaid seen from behind walking away with a small three-legged dog, their prints coming toward the reader, the chimney far across the bay.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, wide tidal mudflats at low tide with a man in blue plaid flannel seen from behind walking away beside a small three-legged dog, their prints leading toward the viewer, a distant chimney across the bay, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: Walking away. The prints come toward us.
